title: After syncing a table from a datasource, nothing tells the administrator what to do next, and form labels are raw column names
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's direct order, verbatim: 「你发现的问题都立卡，安全问题总专用的安全密卡通道，需要进一步分析的进一步测试，还是没有把握的用决策卡。」 (2026-11-05). Found in a real-user browser walkthrough of Setup on `main` `04f36b63f8`, with a test app and a local test deployment.

**Business reason.** Connecting a database is only useful when people can reach the data. Today the flow stops at a success message, while the data is in no app and no ordinary user can read it.

**Reader.** The UI lane dev for the sync dialog in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`, and the server lane for the generated object draft.

**Duplicates.** Searched `sync objects datasource next step app navigation` (33 hits). They are QA run anchors and a closed Setup navigation card; none has this subject.

## Measured

Synced table `spare_parts` from an external SQLite file:

- The toast says 「已从 parts_db 同步 1 个对象。」 with no link and no next step.
- The object is in no app. I reached it only by typing its address.
- An ordinary member gets 403 until someone grants access, which is the right default, but nothing says so.
- The list labels read `Part name`, while the new-record form reads `part_no`, and its title reads `新建Spare Parts`.
- `/api/v1/meta/object` reports its package as `sys_metadata`, meaning it is in no package. #28569 describes a package-less row as one that never exports. I did not test exporting this one.

## Expected

- After sync, the note links to the new object and says what is left: add it to an app, and grant access.
- A form label uses the same readable label as the list.
- The dev checks where a synced object should live under ADR-0146, and says in the PR whether it exports.
